content.comment_body: Hello, In the [company_name] [product_name] app, I can view outputs through the I/O status, but I want to monitor them using the output tag on the control page. How can I assign a tag to a flag or digital output? It seems there is no option to select outputs (Q) or markers (M) in the address list.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing challenges configuring the [company_name] [product_name] app to display output states on the control page. Expected tags, such as outputs (Q) and markers (M), are not available in the address list, making it difficult to assign and visualize these outputs. This highlights a usability issue with the app's process for mapping and selecting I/O tags for control purposes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to directly assign output tags, like flags or digital outputs, on the control page and be able to view and select outputs (Q) or markers (M) from the address list.
